description: Election Commission - Declare that W. S. H. Fernando as a member of the Negombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the resignation of a member and the nomination/declaration of a new member to fill that vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
